L1.en: The king asked who they were. Whose they were.
L1.hi: राजा ने पूछा — ये कौन हैं? किसके हैं?
L1.te: రాజు అడిగాడు — వాళ్ళు ఎవరు? ఎవరి మనుషులు?
L1.speaker: DASHARATHA
L1.speaker_rule: DASHARATHA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L2.hi: विश्वामित्र ने धीरे से जवाब दिया।

L3.en: They don't come on their own, he said. Someone sets them on.
L3.hi: उन्होंने कहा — वो अपने आप नहीं आते। कोई उन्हें उकसाता है।
L3.te: వాళ్ళంతట వాళ్ళు రారు, అన్నాడు. ఎవరో వాళ్ళని ఉసిగొలుపుతారు.
L3.speaker: VISHVAMITRA
L3.speaker_rule: VISHVAMITRA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L5.en: King of the rākṣasas. Brother of Kubera. He has a boon.
L5.hi: राक्षसों का राजा। कुबेर का भाई। उसे वरदान मिला हुआ है।
L5.te: రాక్షసుల రాజు. కుబేరుడి తమ్ముడు. వాడికి వరం ఉంది.

L7.en: He said he couldn't stand against Rāvaṇa, nor could his army.
L7.hi: उन्होंने कहा — रावण के सामने वो ख़ुद नहीं टिक सकते। न उनकी सेना।
L7.te: రావణుడి ముందు తను నిలబడలేడు, తన సైన్యం కూడా — అన్నాడు.
L7.speaker: DASHARATHA
L7.speaker_rule: DASHARATHA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L8.en: How, he asked, could a boy?
L8.hi: उन्होंने पूछा — तो एक बच्चा कैसे?
L8.te: ఇంక ఒక పిల్లాడు ఎలా, అని అడిగాడు.
L8.speaker: DASHARATHA
L8.speaker_rule: DASHARATHA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

L9.hi: एक बार फिर... उन्होंने ना कह दिया।
L9.speaker: DASHARATHA
L9.speaker_rule: DASHARATHA's statement, not narrator fact. Attributed in every language.

screenplay.en: The king asked who they were. Whose they were.
They don't come on their own, he said. Someone sets them on.
King of the rākṣasas. Brother of Kubera. He has a boon.
He said he couldn't stand against Rāvaṇa, nor could his army.
How, he asked, could a boy?

sound.design: The room tone **opens** at beat 8 — full hall reverb, one distant footfall — and closes back at beat 12. A low string returns at beat 5, unresolved, and is gone before the wide. **No score under the name.**
sound.room_tone: continues across a continuous join; never reseated

hero_frame.why: A king reduced to a figure in a vast hall, under the name of someone who is not there. The only poster in the set without a face.
hero_frame.use: poster, share card, and the frame a stranger sees first

share_cut.connect_line: Who are these rākṣasas he fears?

continuity._what: What must not change between cuts.
standing_rules: The lamp stays where it is. Its flame moves; its position does not.
Daśaratha's ring is on the right hand in every hand detail, in every film.
The throne is occupied in films 1–2 and empty from film 3 onward. It is never re-occupied.
Viśvāmitra's staff is planted at his right through films 1–4. It moves once, in film 5.
The sage's cloth and seated posture do not change across four films — that stillness is the performance and a shifted fold breaks it.
Once the king steps down in film 3, he does not return to the dais in any later shot.

per_join.continuous: The frame is IDENTICAL across the join — same plate, same grade, same room tone. Not a similar frame: the same one.
per_join.hard: Location or time has changed. Room tone changes with it.

never: Do not show Rāvaṇa. Not a silhouette, not ten heads, not Laṅkā, not a shadow.
Do not put a musical hit or a sub-drop on the name. The room opening is the effect.
Do not add a flashback or a courtier whispering it.
Do not invent scale — "every kingdom trembled." Three facts only.
Do not let the king collapse. His eyes drop to the floor.
Do not make the second refusal bigger than the first. It is smaller.
